```{r functions, include = FALSE}

# Function to transform raw count data to TPM using the loaded data
counts_to_tpm <- function(count_data, gene_lengths) {
  if (!is.matrix(count_data)) {
    stop("Count data must be a matrix")
  }
  if (!is.numeric(gene_lengths) || length(gene_lengths) != nrow(count_data)) {
    stop("Gene lengths must be a numeric vector with the same length as the number of rows in count data")
  }

  rpk <- count_data / (gene_lengths / 1000)
  scaling_factors <- colSums(rpk)
  tpm <- t(t(rpk) / scaling_factors) * 100000
  return(tpm)
}

# Function to plot z-scores and return clusters
plot_zscores <- function(tpm_data, comparisons, number_genes_map, num_clusters) {
  # Extract column names for the comparison samples
  comparison_samples <- unique(unlist(sapply(comparisons, function(x) {
    unlist(sapply(x, function(y) grep(paste0("^", y), colnames(tpm_data), value = TRUE)))
  })))
  
  # Debugging: Check available column names and comparison_samples
  print("Column names in TPM data:")
  print(colnames(tpm_data))
  print("Comparison samples:")
  print(comparison_samples)
  
  # Subset the TPM data for comparison samples
  tpm_data <- tpm_data[, comparison_samples, drop = FALSE]
  
  mean_TPM <- colMeans(tpm_data)
  sd_TPM <- apply(tpm_data, 2, sd)
  
  zscores <- sweep(tpm_data, 2, mean_TPM, "-")
  zscores <- sweep(zscores, 2, sd_TPM, "/")
  
  df_top <- zscores[order(apply(zscores, 1, function(x) max(x) - min(x)), decreasing = TRUE)[1:number_genes_map],]
  top_matrix <- as.matrix(df_top)
  
  mat_scaled <- t(scale(t(top_matrix)))
  
  heatmap_plot <- Heatmap(mat_scaled, 
                          name = "Z-score",
                          col = rev(brewer.pal(7, "RdBu")),
                          row_km = num_clusters,
                          cluster_columns = FALSE,
                          row_dend_reorder = FALSE,
                          show_column_dend = FALSE,
                          show_row_dend = FALSE,
                          show_row_names = FALSE,
                          row_names_side = NULL,
                          row_title = "%s",  row_title_rot = 0,
                          row_gap = unit(2, "mm"))
  
  # Perform clustering and extract clusters
  hc <- as.hclust(row_dend(heatmap_plot)[[1]])
  row_names <- as.character(row.names(mat_scaled))
  row_clusters <- cutree(hc, k = num_clusters)
  row_clusters <- as.numeric(as.factor(row_clusters))
  cluster_lists <- split(row_names, row_clusters)
  
  return(list(heatmap_plot = heatmap_plot, cluster_lists = cluster_lists))
}

# Function to run clusterProfiler on clusters and create bubble plots

run_cluster_profiler <- function(cluster_lists, pvalueCutoff = 0.05, qvalueCutoff = 0.05, max_terms = 10) {
  results_list <- list()
  plots <- list()
  
  # Set up GO data for semantic similarity
  hsGO <- godata('org.Hs.eg.db', ont = "BP")
  
  for (i in seq_along(cluster_lists)) {
    # Convert the cluster into a vector
    genes <- unlist(cluster_lists[[i]])  # Ensure it's a vector of gene symbols
    
    # Use bitr() to map symbols to Entrez IDs
    converted_cluster <- bitr(
      genes,
      fromType = "ENSEMBL",
      toType = "ENTREZID",
      OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
    )
    
    # Extract unique Entrez IDs
    cluster_entrez_ids <- unique(converted_cluster$ENTREZID)
    
    # Skip if no Entrez IDs are found
    if (length(cluster_entrez_ids) == 0) {
      warning(paste("No valid Entrez IDs for cluster", i))
      next
    }
    
    # Run GO enrichment analysis
    result <- enrichGO(
      gene = cluster_entrez_ids,
      OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
      ont = "BP",
      keyType = "ENTREZID",
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff = pvalueCutoff,
      qvalueCutoff = qvalueCutoff,
      readable = TRUE
    )
    
    # Skip if no GO terms are enriched
    if (is.null(result) || nrow(result) == 0) {
      warning(paste("No GO terms enriched for cluster", i))
      next
    }
    
    # Generate a dotplot for the enriched GO terms
    p <- dotplot(result, showCategory = max_terms) + 
      ggtitle(paste("Cluster", i, "GO Enrichment"))
    plots[[i]] <- p
    
    # Store the results
    results_list[[i]] <- result
  }
  
  # Arrange all plots into a grid
  grid_plots <- marrangeGrob(plots, ncol = 2, nrow = 2)
  
  return(list(results_list = results_list, grid_plots = grid_plots))
}

```

```{r load and setup data, include = FALSE}
# Load necessary files and data from the Rmd setup
tx2gene <- read.csv(paste0(working_dir, "dm6.hg38.tx2gene.csv"), header = TRUE)
samples <- read.csv(paste0(working_dir, "samplesheet_DESeq2.csv"), header = TRUE)
features <- read.table(paste0(working_dir, "dm6.hg38.gtf_gene_annotation_table.txt"), header = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
files <- file.path(working_dir, "salmon_quant", samples$sample, "quant.sf")
names(files) <- samples$sample

# Create a tximport object
txi <- tximport(files, type = "salmon", tx2gene = tx2gene)

# Extract mean gene lengths from txi
gene_lengths <- rowMeans(txi$length)

# Filter out dm6 genes based on chromosome information in the features file
dm6_genes <- features %>% filter(grepl("dm6", Chromosome)) %>% pull(gene_id)
valid_rows <- !rownames(txi$counts) %in% dm6_genes

count_data <- txi$counts[valid_rows, ]
gene_lengths <- gene_lengths[valid_rows]

# Transform counts to TPM
tpm_data <- counts_to_tpm(count_data, gene_lengths)
```

```{r plot heatmap}
# Define comparisons (unlimited list)
comparisons <- list(c("GSK591_cytoplasm", "DMSO_cytoplasm"),
                    c("GSK591_nucleoplasm", "DMSO_nucleoplasm"),
                    c("GSK591_chromatin", "DMSO_chromatin"))

# Plot z-scores with specified top genes and clusters
number_genes_map <- 2000  # Example: number of top genes to plot
num_clusters <- 3  # Example: number of clusters
result <- plot_zscores(tpm_data, comparisons, number_genes_map, num_clusters)
heatmap_plot <- result$heatmap_plot
cluster_lists <- result$cluster_lists

# Print heatmap
print(heatmap_plot)

# Save the heatmap as a pdf file
pdf("TPM_zscore_heatmap.pdf")
print(heatmap_plot)
dev.off()




# Run clusterProfiler on clusters
go_gene_list <- unique(sort(rownames(tpm_data)))

#run cluster profiler
profiler_results <- run_cluster_profiler(cluster_lists, go_gene_list)
results_list <- profiler_results$results_list
grid_plots <- profiler_results$grid_plots

# Print the bubble plots for GO enrichment results
print(grid_plots)

# Save the GO enrichment bubble plots as a pdf file
pdf("GO_enrichment_bubble_plots.pdf")
print(grid_plots)
dev.off()

# Output gene names in each cluster
for (i in 1:length(cluster_lists)) {
  cat("Cluster", i, "genes:\n")
  print(cluster_lists[[i]])
}
```
